Let current be that representative. If its successor has the same value, bypass the successor by connecting current to the node after it. Do not advance current yet: another equal node may follow. When the successor differs, the current run is finished, and current can move forward to represent the next run.

Each iteration either removes one duplicate or advances past one retained node, so the procedure finishes after linear work. An empty list needs no special allocation, and a singleton already meets the requirement.
